name: unet48_dice_budget70_75_fold0_seed0
selection_metric: Final validation macro hard Dice over classes 1 and 2, averaged across the 52 validation patients, after the complete candidate-specific cosine schedule. Best intermediate checkpoint does not select the budget.
search_policy: Start at 400 updates. Double if below target, halve if above with no measured lower bracket, then bisect measured below/above brackets at integer updates; abort contradictory or exhausted brackets. No monotonicity guarantee.
execution: One sbatch allocation, sequential fresh Dice-only U-Net-48 candidates. Calculate SwinUNETR and nnU-Net allowances after selection; do not train those models or constraints.
lr_policy: Same initial 1e-4 AdamW, weight decay 1e-5, 5% warmup and cosine to 1e-6 over each full candidate schedule; no early stopping.
compute_accounting: Exact per-candidate update cap using declared arithmetic cost; record all search compute separately.
inference_scope: Exploratory fold 0 seed 0 budget selection; freeze before subsequent folds/seeds and constraints.
